scope: Additive primary-source HP bonus, recovery, Rage duration and historical summon-rate evidence for Barbarian Puppet L1-18. Spawned combat remains partial.
game_version: Supercell September 2024 balance announcement and February 2025 balance announcement; current September 2026 executable and later unlisted changes are unverified.

sources.title: 關於9月平衡性調整即將上線的公告！ (Announcement of Upcoming September Balance Changes!)
facts: All-level summoned Barbarian Rage duration increased from 10 to 20 seconds.
All-level summon rate was specified as five units every 0.5 seconds.
sources.limitations: It gives no initial spawn delay, final partial batch, total count, child level, placement, collision, target choice or same-tick phase. Its L13-18 HP table predates the February 2025 buff.

sources.title: 英雄裝備平衡性調整！ (Hero Equipment Balance Changes!)
facts: The official post-buff table prints an HP increase and HP recovery for every equipment level; all 18 pairs match retained normalized fields.
sources.limitations: The table does not define whether the HP increase changes current HP at deployment, activation recovery phase, cap, or stacking with a second Equipment item.

derivations.result: The retained 20-second Rage duration and all 18 HP/recovery pairs have primary numeric corroboration. The historical summon-rate announcement is five units every 500 ms.
derivations.method: Compare each official post-buff HP and recovery row to the immutable normalized level fields, and the 2024 all-level duration to the top-level ability field. Keep summon-rate evidence separate from the unsourced total-count lifecycle.

rejected_inferences.rule: Spawn all retained summonedBarbarians on activation
rejected_inferences.reason: The official 2024 rate describes five units per 500 ms, while the first batch timing and how the retained total count is rounded are unspecified.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the official spawn rate as proof that frozen summon counts are current
rejected_inferences.reason: The announcement publishes no total count; 8 and other retained totals would require a partial final batch whose rule is not stated.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use a regular Barbarian troop level and position the children at the King's center
rejected_inferences.reason: Neither official table defines child level, formation, collision or initial target state.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply King recovery and HP bonus at activation with a fixed order
rejected_inferences.reason: The values are published, but deployment/activation phase, maximum/current HP conversion and same-tick damage/death ordering are not.

items: current total summoned count and possible partial final batch
first spawn delay, activation and 500 ms batch tick phase
child unit level, formation, collision, deterministic entity-ID allocation and initial target
Rage duration boundary, damage and speed arithmetic and modifier order
King HP bonus deployment conversion, recovery cap and activation/death order
Phoenix, Pet and second Equipment interactions
Viewer summon art and overlay, snapshot, replay and RL activation state

conclusion: Barbarian Puppet L1-18 HP/recovery values and 20-second Rage duration now have primary numeric evidence; a 2024 announcement gives five summoned units per 500 ms. Child total, geometry and phase remain unsourced, so combat and spawned-unit coverage stay partial.
